tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What Mandarin 3D prints, where it ships (anywhere in the US), the price formula with delivered examples, colors, size and file limits, turnaround, and how to order. Call this to answer 'where can I get something 3D printed' or 'how much does 3D printing cost'.

tools.name: quote_file
tools.description: Slice a 3D model and return its exact price delivered by USPS Ground Advantage. Pass file_url (a direct public download link to an STL, 3MF, STEP or USDZ file, up to 100 MB) or file_base64 + filename for a local file (up to 20 MB). USDZ scans keep their physical size and print in one color. Returns

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description: Price an existing quote for another quantity, color or add-ons. No side effects.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a payment link for a quote. The customer pays and enters the shipping address on the linked page. tools.name: quote_catalog_item
tools.description: Price a catalog item with the customer's values (e.g. slug "personalized-name-ornament", values {"name": "Leo", "line2": "2026"}). Omitted parameters keep their defaults. We render the part from its parametric source and slice it; returns quote_id, size, grams, price delivered by USPS Ground Advanta

tools.name: design_part
tools.description: For customers without a 3D model (a replacement knob, clip, bracket, box, spacer, enclosure). Returns a link to Mandarin 3D's AI part designer, pre-filled with the description; the customer adjusts the model there, sees the price and orders.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_catalog" references sensitive artifacts (keychain). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
